definitions.explanation: The figure obtained by adding up a set of values and dividing by how many there are. Used wherever data is summarized: test scores, measurements, survey results, and economic statistics.

examples.japanese: {平均値|へいきんち}を{計算|けいさん}した。
この{数値|すうち}は{平均値|へいきんち}をやや{上回|うわまわ}っている。
examples.english: This figure is slightly above the average.

examples.japanese: {極端|きょくたん}な{値|あたい}が{一|ひと}つあると、{平均値|へいきんち}は{全体|ぜんたい}の{様子|ようす}を{正|ただ}しく{表|あらわ}さないことがある。
examples.english: When there is one extreme value, the mean sometimes fails to represent the data accurately.

notes:
Formed from {平均|へいきん} (average) plus {値|ち} (value). In casual speech people often just say {平均|へいきん}; {平均値|へいきんち} is the precise term used when contrasting it with other statistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均値|へいきんち}を{求|もと}める: to find the mean
- {平均値|へいきんち}を{上回|うわまわ}る: to exceed the average
- {平均値|へいきんち}を{下回|したまわ}る: to fall below the average
- {全体|ぜんたい}の{平均値|へいきんち}: the overall average

RELATED TERMS:
- {中央値|ちゅうおうち}: median — the middle value, less affected by outliers
- {最大値|さいだいち} / {最小値|さいしょうち}: maximum / minimum value
